scripts.script:
--========================================================--
-- ULTRA INSTINCT DODGE(FIXES VERSION)========================================================--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--========================================================--
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================--

local LEFT_EMOTE_ID = 90488938832099
local RIGHT_EMOTE_ID = 88170433716621
local CROUCH_EMOTE_ID = 137710349373014

local LEFT_DURATION = 1.75
local RIGHT_DURATION = 0.75
local CROUCH_DURATION = 0.75

local DODGE_DISTANCE = 5
local CROUCH_DOWN = 0.6

local DODGE_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://7251381246"

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================--

local character = nil
local humanoid = nil
local root = nil

local characterVersion = 0

local dodging = false
local dodgeNumber = 0
local dodgeToken = 0

local currentTween = nil
local currentTrack = nil

--========================================================--
-- ORIGINAL COLLISION
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- These values stay saved for the ENTIRE life of
-- the character. They are NOT cleared after each dodge.
--========================================================--

local originalCollision = {}

--========================================================--
-- MOVEMENT SAVE
--========================================================--

local savedWalkSpeed = 16
local savedJumpPower = 50
local savedJumpHeight = 7.2
local savedAutoRotate = true
local savedUseJumpPower = true

--========================================================--
-- CLEAR OLD DATA
--========================================================--

local function clearOldData()

	table.clear(originalCollision)

	currentTween = nil
	currentTrack = nil

	character = nil
	humanoid = nil
	root = nil

	dodging = false
	dodgeNumber = 0
end

--========================================================--
-- SAVE ORIGINAL COLLISION
--========================================================--

local function saveOriginalCollision(char)

	table.clear(originalCollision)

	for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			originalCollision[obj] = obj.CanCollide

		end

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- RESTORE ORIGINAL COLLISION
--
-- FIX:
-- DO NOT clear originalCollision here.
--
-- The saved values must survive multiple dodges.
--========================================================--

local function restoreOriginalCollision(char)

	if not char then
		return
	end

	for part, originalValue in pairs(originalCollision) do

		if part
			and part.Parent
			and part:IsDescendantOf(char)
			and part:IsA("BasePart") then

			part.CanCollide = originalValue

		end

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- DISABLE COLLISION
--========================================================--

local function disableDodgeCollision(char)

	if not char then
		return
	end

	for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			obj.CanCollide = false

		end

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- STOP OLD TWEEN
--========================================================--

local function cancelCurrentTween()

	if currentTween then

		pcall(function()
			currentTween:Cancel()
		end)

		currentTween = nil

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- STOP OLD ANIMATION
--========================================================--

local function stopCurrentAnimation(hum)

	if not hum then
		return
	end

	local animator =
		hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if animator then

		for _, track in ipairs(
			animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
		) do

			pcall(function()

				track.Looped = false
				track:Stop(0)

			end)

		end

	end

	currentTrack = nil
end

--========================================================--
-- RESTORE MOVEMENT
--========================================================--

local function restoreMovement(hum)

	if not hum then
		return
	end

	hum.WalkSpeed = savedWalkSpeed

	if savedUseJumpPower then

		hum.JumpPower = savedJumpPower

	else

		hum.JumpHeight = savedJumpHeight

	end

	hum.AutoRotate = savedAutoRotate

	hum:SetStateEnabled(
		Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
		true
	)
end

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER SETUP
--========================================================--

local function setupCharacter(newCharacter)

	--====================================================--
	-- INVALIDATE OLD CHARACTER
	--====================================================--

	characterVersion += 1

	local thisCharacterVersion =
		characterVersion

	dodgeToken += 1

	cancelCurrentTween()

	-- Clear ONLY because this is a brand-new character.
	table.clear(originalCollision)

	dodging = false
	dodgeNumber = 0
	currentTrack = nil

	--====================================================--
	-- SET NEW CHARACTER
	--====================================================--

	character = newCharacter

	humanoid =
		character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	root =
		character:WaitForChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	--====================================================--
	-- SAVE ORIGINAL COLLISION
	--====================================================--

	saveOriginalCollision(character)

	--====================================================--
	-- NORMAL MOVEMENT
	--====================================================--

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16

	if humanoid.UseJumpPower then

		humanoid.JumpPower = 50

	else

		humanoid.JumpHeight = 7.2

	end

	humanoid.AutoRotate = true

	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
		Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
		true
	)

	--====================================================--
	-- DEATH CLEANUP
	--====================================================--

	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()

		if thisCharacterVersion
			~= characterVersion then

			return
		end

		-- Invalidate all old dodge timers.
		dodgeToken += 1

		dodging = false

		cancelCurrentTween()

		stopCurrentAnimation(humanoid)

		-- Restore this character one final time.
		restoreOriginalCollision(character)

		-- Now it is safe to clear it because
		-- this character is dead.
		table.clear(originalCollision)

	end)

	--====================================================--
	-- EXTRA BODY PART SAFETY
	--====================================================--

	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)

		if thisCharacterVersion
			~= characterVersion then

			return
		end

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			-- Save new parts only when the character
			-- is not currently dodging.
			if not dodging then

				originalCollision[obj] =
					obj.CanCollide

			end

		end

	end)
end

--========================================================--
-- INITIAL CHARACTER
--========================================================--

if player.Character then

	setupCharacter(
		player.Character
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- RESPAWN
--========================================================--

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)

	setupCharacter(newCharacter)

end)

--========================================================--
-- LOCK MOVEMENT
--========================================================--

local function lockMovement()

	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	savedWalkSpeed =
		humanoid.WalkSpeed

	savedJumpPower =
		humanoid.JumpPower

	savedJumpHeight =
		humanoid.JumpHeight

	savedAutoRotate =
		humanoid.AutoRotate

	savedUseJumpPower =
		humanoid.UseJumpPower

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

	if humanoid.UseJumpPower then

		humanoid.JumpPower = 0

	else

		humanoid.JumpHeight = 0

	end

	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
		Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
		false
	)
end

--========================================================--
-- DODGE SOUND
--========================================================--

local function playDodgeSound()

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local sound =
		Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.Name =
		"UltraInstinctDodgeSound"

	sound.SoundId =
		DODGE_SOUND_ID

	sound.Volume = 1

	sound.Parent = root

	sound:Play()

	sound.Ended:Connect(function()

		if sound then
			sound:Destroy()
		end

	end)

	task.delay(3, function()

		if sound
			and sound.Parent then

			sound:Destroy()

		end

	end)
end

--========================================================--
-- PLAY EMOTE
--========================================================--

local function playEmote(emoteId)

	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	stopCurrentAnimation(humanoid)

	local success, track =
		pcall(function()

			return humanoid:
				PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(
					emoteId
				)

		end)

	if success and track then

		currentTrack = track

		pcall(function()

			track.Looped = false
			track:Play()

		end)

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- MOVE SIDEWAYS
--========================================================--

local function moveSideways(
	direction,
	token,
	version
)

	if not root then
		return
	end

	if token ~= dodgeToken then
		return
	end

	if version ~= characterVersion then
		return
	end

	local targetCFrame =
		root.CFrame
		+ (
			root.CFrame.RightVector
			* direction
			* DODGE_DISTANCE
		)

	local tween =
		TweenService:Create(

			root,

			TweenInfo.new(
				0.5,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
				Enum.EasingDirection.Out
			),

			{
				CFrame = targetCFrame
			}

		)

	-- Only this dodge owns this tween.
	currentTween = tween

	tween:Play()

	tween.Completed:Wait()

	-- Don't let an old tween clear a newer tween.
	if currentTween == tween then

		currentTween = nil

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- CROUCH
--========================================================--

local function crouchMove(
	token,
	version
)

	if not root then
		return
	end

	if token ~= dodgeToken then
		return
	end

	if version ~= characterVersion then
		return
	end

	local originalCFrame =
		root.CFrame

	local downCFrame =
		originalCFrame
		+ Vector3.new(
			0,
			-CROUCH_DOWN,
			0
		)

	--====================================================--
	-- MOVE DOWN
	--====================================================--

	local downTween =
		TweenService:Create(

			root,

			TweenInfo.new(
				0.2,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
				Enum.EasingDirection.Out
			),

			{
				CFrame = downCFrame
			}

		)

	currentTween = downTween

	downTween:Play()

	downTween.Completed:Wait()

	if token ~= dodgeToken then
		return
	end

	if version ~= characterVersion then
		return
	end

	if currentTween == downTween then
		currentTween = nil
	end

	--====================================================--
	-- MOVE BACK UP
	--====================================================--

	local upTween =
		TweenService:Create(

			root,

			TweenInfo.new(
				0.2,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
				Enum.EasingDirection.In
			),

			{
				CFrame = originalCFrame
			}

		)

	currentTween = upTween

	upTween:Play()

	upTween.Completed:Wait()

	if version ~= characterVersion then
		return
	end

	if currentTween == upTween then
		currentTween = nil
	end
end

--========================================================--
-- END DODGE
--========================================================--

local function endDodge(
	token,
	version
)

	--====================================================--
	-- OLD DODGE PROTECTION
	--====================================================--

	if token ~= dodgeToken then
		return
	end

	if version ~= characterVersion then
		return
	end

	if not character
		or not humanoid then

		return
	end

	--====================================================--
	-- END CURRENT DODGE
	--====================================================--

	dodging = false

	stopCurrentAnimation(humanoid)

	--====================================================--
	-- RESTORE ORIGINAL COLLISION
	--
	-- The saved table is intentionally NOT cleared.
	--====================================================--

	restoreOriginalCollision(character)

	--====================================================--
	-- RESTORE MOVEMENT
	--====================================================--

	restoreMovement(humanoid)

end

--========================================================--
-- MAIN DODGE
--========================================================--

local function dodge()

	if not character
		or not humanoid
		or not root then

		return
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	--====================================================--
	-- NEW DODGE TOKEN
	--====================================================--

	dodgeToken += 1

	local token =
		dodgeToken

	local version =
		characterVersion

	--====================================================--
	-- LOCK MOVEMENT
	--====================================================--

	if not dodging then

		dodging = true

		lockMovement()

	end

	--====================================================--
	-- DISABLE COLLISION
	--====================================================--

	disableDodgeCollision(character)

	--====================================================--
	-- CANCEL ONLY THE OLD MOVEMENT
	--====================================================--

	cancelCurrentTween()

	--====================================================--
	-- NEXT DODGE
	--====================================================--

	dodgeNumber += 1

	if dodgeNumber > 3 then

		dodgeNumber = 1

	end

	playDodgeSound()

	--====================================================--
	-- 1: LEFT
	--====================================================--

	if dodgeNumber == 1 then

		playEmote(
			LEFT_EMOTE_ID
		)

		task.spawn(function()

			moveSideways(
				-1,
				token,
				version
			)

		end)

		task.delay(
			LEFT_DURATION,
			function()

				endDodge(
					token,
					version
				)

			end
		)

	--====================================================--
	-- 2: RIGHT
	--====================================================--

	elseif dodgeNumber == 2 then

		playEmote(
			RIGHT_EMOTE_ID
		)

		task.spawn(function()

			moveSideways(
				1,
				token,
				version
			)

		end)

		task.delay(
			RIGHT_DURATION,
			function()

				endDodge(
					token,
					version
				)

			end
		)

	--====================================================--
	-- 3: CROUCH
	--====================================================--

	elseif dodgeNumber == 3 then

		playEmote(
			CROUCH_EMOTE_ID
		)

		task.spawn(function()

			crouchMove(
				token,
				version
			)

		end)

		task.delay(
			CROUCH_DURATION,
			function()

				endDodge(
					token,
					version
				)

			end
		)

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- GUI
--========================================================--

local playerGui =
	player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local oldGui =
	playerGui:FindFirstChild(
		"UltraInstinctGui"
	)

if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

local gui =
	Instance.new("ScreenGui")

gui.Name =
	"UltraInstinctGui"

gui.DisplayOrder =
	999999

gui.ResetOnSpawn =
	false

gui.Parent =
	playerGui

--========================================================--
-- BUTTON
--========================================================--

local button =
	Instance.new("TextButton")

button.Name =
	"UltraInstinctButton"

button.Size =
	UDim2.new(
		0,
		155,
		0,
		65
	)

button.Position =
	UDim2.new(
		1,
		-175,
		1,
		-105
	)

button.BackgroundTransparency =
	0.15

button.Text =
	"ULTRA\nINSTINCT"

button.TextScaled =
	true

button.TextWrapped =
	true

button.Font =
	Enum.Font.GothamBold

button.TextColor3 =
	Color3.new(
		1,
		1,
		1
	)

button.Parent =
	gui

--========================================================--
-- CORNER
--========================================================--

local corner =
	Instance.new("UICorner")

corner.CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(
		0,
		18
	)

corner.Parent =
	button

--========================================================--
-- STROKE
--========================================================--

local stroke =
	Instance.new("UIStroke")

stroke.Thickness = 3
stroke.Parent = button

--========================================================--
-- MOBILE
--========================================================--

button.Activated:Connect(function()

	dodge()

end)

--========================================================--
-- PC Q
--========================================================--

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
	function(input, processed)

		if processed then
			return
		end

		if input.KeyCode ==
			Enum.KeyCode.Q then

			dodge()

		end

	end
)

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getBuildingTools()
    local tool = (Player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and Player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Building Tools+")) 
        or (Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Building Tools+"))
        or (Player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and Player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("F3X"))
        or (Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("F3X"))

    if not tool and Player.Backpack then
        for _, v in ipairs(Player.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Tool") and (v.Name:lower():find("f3x") or v.Name:lower():find("fork") or v:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI")) then
                tool = v
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not tool and Player.Character then
        for _, v in ipairs(Player.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Tool") and (v.Name:lower():find("f3x") or v.Name:lower():find("fork") or v:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI")) then
                tool = v
                break
            end
        end
    end

    return tool
end

local function applySparklesToAll()
    local BuildingTools = getBuildingTools()
    if not BuildingTools then return end

    local ServerEndpoint = BuildingTools:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") and BuildingTools.SyncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint")
    if not ServerEndpoint then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local existingSparkles = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sparkles")
                    if not existingSparkles then
                        ServerEndpoint:InvokeServer("CreateDecorations", {{Part = part, DecorationType = "Sparkles"}})
                    end
                    
                    local sData = {
                        Part = part, 
                        DecorationType = "Sparkles"
                    }
                    ServerEndpoint:InvokeServer("SyncDecorate", {sData})
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
end

applySparklesToAll()

scripts.title: Flux Universal
scripts.features:
A universal Roblox exploit script that provides a mod menu GUI with cheat features for any Roblox game. It detects which executor is running it and loads the appropriate version.

Two Versions
PC Version — for executors like Volt, Potassium, Wave, Madium, Real, Isaeva, Cosmic, Velocity, SirHurt, Solara, Xeno

Mobile Version — for Delta and Codex on Android/iOS

Player Tab
WalkSpeed — adjustable slider (16–300) with toggle

JumpPower — adjustable slider (50–300) with toggle

Health — set max health up to 1000 with toggle

TP Tool — gives a FluxTPTool you equip and click to teleport to where you're pointing; can also be removed

XRay — makes walls/environment transparent with batched processing and live updates for newly added parts

Noclip — walk through walls (toggle + N keybind on PC)

Infinite Jump — jump repeatedly in mid-air (PC: Space key; Mobile: dedicated jump button)

Fullbright — enhanced lighting (brightness, no shadows, no fog, exposure, color shifts)

Anti AFK — prevents idle kick

Hitbox Expander — enlarges player hitboxes for easier hits, with adjustable size (2–50 studs), transparency slider (0–1), and an "Ignore Team" option

FPS Cap — limit or uncap framerate with slider (1–9999) and presets: 60, 120, 144, 240, 360, Unlimited

Player Debug — live labels for position, velocity, FPS, uptime, player count; buttons to copy Game ID, Server ID, Position, and a Rejoin Script

Teleport to Subplaces — save custom Place IDs with names, one-click join buttons, add/clear entries, and persistent JSON storage

ESP Tab (Extra Sensory Perception)
Player highlight, names, tracers, skeleton, boxes, health bars, distance

Custom HEX color pickers for each element (saved to FluxUniversal_Colors.json)

Works with both R6 and R15 rigs

Skeleton drawing supports R15 full-body connections and R6 simplified connections

Health bar color shifts based on health percentage

Aimbot Tab
Aimbot:

Lock camera onto nearest player (right-click on PC, toggle on mobile)

Aim Part selector (Head / Torso)

Smoothness slider

FOV circle with adjustable size and custom HEX color

Velocity prediction with adjustable multiplier

Auto-read projectile speed from weapon NumberValues, with fallback speed slider

Humanization with adjustable intensity

Team filter, visibility check

Show/hide FOV circle

Triggerbot:

Auto-fire when crosshair is on target

Adjustable trigger delay, angle threshold, click hold duration, and weapon fire cooldown

Require Weapon toggle

Team filter and visibility check apply

Troll Tab
Touch Fling — launch players on contact

Invisibility — hides your character using a seat anchor method

Orbit Player — continuously circle around a chosen target player at adjustable speed and distance (type the player's name to lock on, with a refresh button)

Headsit Player — sit on a chosen player's head (type the player's name, with refresh button; jump to stop)

Spin — spin your character using AlignOrientation (visible to others) with adjustable speed

Teleport to Player — toggle to continuously teleport to a chosen player, "TP Once" instant button, adjustable offset, with refresh button

Interact Tab (Mobile Version)
TAP TO INTERACT button — fire all nearby ProximityPrompts instantly

Auto Interact — repeatedly triggers prompts within radius (0.3s interval)

Instant Interact — fires prompts the moment they appear

Interact Radius slider (5–100 studs)

Floating draggable INTERACT button on mobile

PC users press E to interact

scripts.script:
local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game:GetService("CoreGui"))
sg.Name = "SoundServiceSpammer"

local main = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 380)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -190)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.Text = "SOUND SERVICE SPAMMER"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 50)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 11
Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 0)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 12
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() sg:Destroy() end)

local refreshBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
refreshBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 24)
refreshBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32)
refreshBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
refreshBtn.Text = "REFRESH"
refreshBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
refreshBtn.TextSize = 10
refreshBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
refreshBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", refreshBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
status.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 24)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 32)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "Ready"
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 10
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local listFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", main)
listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 180)
listFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 62)
listFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
listFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
listFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4
listFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Instance.new("UICorner", listFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

local uiList = Instance.new("UIListLayout", listFrame)
uiList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
uiList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

local spamFrame = Instance.new("Frame", main)
spamFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 120)
spamFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 248)
spamFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
spamFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", spamFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local spamTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", spamFrame)
spamTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
spamTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
spamTitle.Text = "SPAM CONTROLS"
spamTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50)
spamTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
spamTitle.TextSize = 10

local selectedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", spamFrame)
selectedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
selectedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20)
selectedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
selectedLabel.Text = "Selected: None"
selectedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
selectedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
selectedLabel.TextSize = 9
selectedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", spamFrame)
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 16)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "Speed:"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedLabel.TextSize = 10
speedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local speedBox = Instance.new("TextBox", spamFrame)
speedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 22)
speedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 37)
speedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
speedBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
speedBox.Text = "0.05"
speedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedBox.TextSize = 11
Instance.new("UICorner", speedBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

local spamBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", spamFrame)
spamBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
spamBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 65)
spamBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50)
spamBtn.Text = "START SPAM"
spamBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
spamBtn.TextSize = 11
spamBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
spamBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", spamBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

local stopAllBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", spamFrame)
stopAllBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
stopAllBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 96)
stopAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
stopAllBtn.Text = "STOP ALL"
stopAllBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
stopAllBtn.TextSize = 10
stopAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
stopAllBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", stopAllBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

local selectedSound = nil
local spamActive = false
local spamThread = nil

local function refreshList()
    for _, v in pairs(listFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("TextButton") then v:Destroy() end
    end
    
    local soundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
    local sounds = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(soundService:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Sound") then
            table.insert(sounds, v)
        end
    end
    
    if #sounds == 0 then
        local none = Instance.new("TextLabel", listFrame)
        none.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
        none.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        none.Text = "No sounds in SoundService"
        none.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
        none.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        none.TextSize = 10
        return
    end
    
    for _, sound in ipairs(sounds) do
        local row = Instance.new("TextButton", listFrame)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        row.Text = sound.Name
        row.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        row.TextSize = 11
        row.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        
        row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if spamActive then return end
            selectedSound = sound
            selectedLabel.Text = "Selected: " .. sound.Name
            selectedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            sound:Play()
            status.Text = "Played: " .. sound.Name
            status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                if status and status.Parent and status.Text == "Played: " .. sound.Name then
                    status.Text = "Ready"
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
    
    listFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #sounds * 31)
    status.Text = "Loaded: " .. #sounds .. " sounds"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
end

refreshBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(refreshList)

stopAllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    spamActive = false
    if spamThread then task.cancel(spamThread) end
    spamBtn.Text = "START SPAM"
    spamBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50)
    status.Text = "Stopped"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
end)

spamBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not selectedSound then
        status.Text = "Select a sound first"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        return
    end
    
    spamActive = not spamActive
    
    if spamActive then
        local delayTime = tonumber(speedBox.Text) or 0.05
        spamBtn.Text = "STOP SPAM"
        spamBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50)
        status.Text = "Spamming: " .. selectedSound.Name .. " @ " .. delayTime .. "s"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
        
        spamThread = task.spawn(function()
            while spamActive and selectedSound and selectedSound.Parent do
                selectedSound:Play()
                task.wait(delayTime)
            end
            spamActive = false
            spamBtn.Text = "START SPAM"
            spamBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50)
            if status and status.Parent then
                status.Text = "Ready"
                status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
            end
        end)
    else
        if spamThread then task.cancel(spamThread) end
        spamBtn.Text = "START SPAM"
        spamBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50)
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
    end
end)

refreshList()
